fixes.P0301: Likely a fouled spark plug or failing ignition coil on cylinder 1. Check plug condition and coil resistance before replacing.

verification.reviewBody: This usually takes a few minutes. We will let you know as soon as it finishes — you can keep using the app in the meantime.
verification.inProgressBody: You started a verification but did not finish it. Pick up where you left off — taking jobs needs a verified identity.
verification.inProgressBodyOptional: You started a verification but did not finish it. It is optional, and you can pick up where you left off whenever you want.
verification.declinedBody: We could not verify your identity, so you cannot take jobs yet. You can try again with a different document or better lighting.
verification.declinedBodyOptional: We could not verify your identity. Nothing is blocked — you can keep requesting assistance — and you can try again with a different document or better lighting.
verification.notStartedBody: Taking jobs needs a verified identity. Everything else works without it.
verification.notStartedBodyOptional: Verifying is optional. You do not need it to request assistance — it just shows mechanics who they are dealing with. You can do it whenever you want.
verification.approvedBody: You are all set. You can request assistance and use every feature.
